fullText.simplified:
棋子

    这几天曹操有点儿忙。北方的元少做了几件大事，又得到了一些地方。曹操知道，元少很快就会带着军队打到南方来，曹操会是他第一个要打的人。助手们很着急，每天都来和曹操开会。当然，曹操也没有忘了刘备和皇帝。他让聪明的助手去跟着皇帝，看他每天和刘备做些什么。
    助手回来以后，每次都对他说一样的话：“曹大人，皇帝每天都请刘备去他那儿，做什么事都带着刘备，他去哪儿刘备就去哪儿。这不是好事，我们应该杀了刘备。”
    曹操没有说话，心里非常不高兴。他不喜欢皇帝和刘备在一起。皇帝是他拿在手里的棋子，他让棋子怎么走，棋子就要怎么走，棋子不能有自己的想法，更不能有像刘备这样的朋友。刘备是个聪明人，虽然现在还没有自己的军队，但以后一定能做大事。这样的人和皇帝走得近，不是好事。
    那杀了刘备？虽然杀人不难，但曹操还不想杀他。第一，刘备是“皇叔”，杀“皇叔”是大事。如果刘备没做坏事，那杀了他，会让其他官员不相信自己。第二，刘备是个聪明人，曹操喜欢聪明人，他希望刘备能做他的人，为他做事。
    但是，人虽然不杀，但曹操还是得让他们知道自己不高兴了，也得让每个人都知道，国家最大的人是他曹操。
    他想了想，对助手说：“你去告诉皇帝和刘备，明天城里有骑马比赛，要他们带马来比赛。也告诉其他官员，让大家都来看比赛。”
    助手不明白曹操的意思，但也知道不用问，曹大人说什么，自己就去做什么，这一定不会错。
fullText.traditional:
棋子

    這幾天曹操有點兒忙。北方的元少做了幾件大事，又得到了一些地方。曹操知道，元少很快就會帶著軍隊打到南方來，曹操會是他第一個要打的人。助手們很著急，每天都來和曹操開會。當然，曹操也沒有忘了劉備和皇帝。他讓聰明的助手去跟著皇帝，看他每天和劉備做些什麼。
    助手回來以後，每次都對他說一樣的話：“曹大人，皇帝每天都請劉備去他那兒，做什麼事都帶著劉備，他去哪兒劉備就去哪兒。這不是好事，我們應該殺了劉備。”
    曹操沒有說話，心裡非常不高興。他不喜歡皇帝和劉備在一起。皇帝是他拿在手裡的棋子，他讓棋子怎麼走，棋子就要怎麼走，棋子不能有自己的想法，更不能有像劉備這樣的朋友。劉備是個聰明人，雖然現在還沒有自己的軍隊，但以後一定能做大事。這樣的人和皇帝走得近，不是好事。
    那殺了劉備？雖然殺人不難，但曹操還不想殺他。第一，劉備是“皇叔”，殺“皇叔”是大事。如果劉備沒做壞事，那殺了他，會讓其他官員不相信自己。第二，劉備是個聰明人，曹操喜歡聰明人，他希望劉備能做他的人，為他做事。
    但是，人雖然不殺，但曹操還是得讓他們知道自己不高興了，也得讓每個人都知道，國家最大的人是他曹操。
    他想了想，對助手說：“你去告訴皇帝和劉備，明天城裡有騎馬比賽，要他們帶馬來比賽。也告訴其他官員，讓大家都來看比賽。”
    助手不明白曹操的意思，但也知道不用問，曹大人說什麼，自己就去做什麼，這一定不會錯。

sentences.simplified: 这几天曹操有点儿忙。北方的元少做了几件大事，又得到了一些地方。
sentences.traditional: 這幾天曹操有點兒忙。北方的元少做了幾件大事，又得到了一些地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jǐ tiān cáo cāo yǒu diǎn'r máng běi fāng de yuán shào zuò le jǐ jiàn dà shì yòu dé dào le yì xiē dì fang
sentences.english: Cao Cao had been quite busy these days. Yuan Shao in the north had done some great things and taken some territory.

sentences.simplified: 曹操知道，元少很快就会带着军队打到南方来，
sentences.traditional: 曹操知道，元少很快就會帶著軍隊打到南方來，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo zhī dào yuán shào hěn kuài jiù huì dài zhe jūn duì dǎ dào nán fāng lái
sentences.english: Cao Cao knew that Yuan Shao would soon bring his troops to the south, ..

sentences.simplified: 曹操会是他第一个要打的人。
sentences.traditional: 曹操會是他第一個要打的人。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo huì shì tā dì yī ge yào dǎ de rén
sentences.english: .. and Cao Cao would be the first person he would fight.

sentences.simplified: 助手们很着急，每天都来和曹操开会。
sentences.traditional: 助手們很著急，每天都來和曹操開會。
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu men hěn zháo jí měi tiān dōu lái hé cáo cāo kāi huì
sentences.english: His assistants were very anxious and came to have meetings with Cao Cao every day.

sentences.simplified: 当然，曹操也没有忘了刘备和皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 當然，曹操也沒有忘了劉備和皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán cáo cāo yě méi yǒu wàng le liú bèi hé huáng dì
sentences.english: Of course, Cao Cao did not forget about Liu Bei and the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 他让聪明的助手去跟着皇帝，看他每天和刘备做些什么。
sentences.traditional: 他讓聰明的助手去跟著皇帝，看他每天和劉備做些什麼。
sentences.pinyin: tā ràng cōng ming de zhù shǒu qù gēn zhe huáng dì kàn tā měi tiān hé liú bèi zuò xiē shén me
sentences.english: He asked his smart assistant to follow the emperor to see what he did with Liu Bei every day.

sentences.simplified: 助手回来以后，每次都对他说一样的话：
sentences.traditional: 助手回來以後，每次都對他說一樣的話：
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu huí lái yǐ hòu měi cì dōu duì tā shuō yí yàng de huà
sentences.english: When the assistant returned, he said the same thing every time:

sentences.simplified: “曹大人，皇帝每天都请刘备去他那儿，
sentences.traditional: “曹大人，皇帝每天都請劉備去他那兒，
sentences.pinyin: cáo dà ren huáng dì měi tiān dōu qǐng liú bèi qù tā nà'r
sentences.english: “Lord Cao, the emperor invites Liu Bei to his place every day.

sentences.simplified: 做什么事都带着刘备，他去哪儿刘备就去哪儿。
sentences.traditional: 做什麼事都帶著劉備，他去哪兒劉備就去哪兒。
sentences.pinyin: zuò shén me shì dōu dài zhe liú bèi tā qù nǎ'r liú bèi jiù qù nǎ'r
sentences.english: He takes Liu Bei with him whatever he is doing. Liu Bei goes wherever he goes.

sentences.simplified: 这不是好事，我们应该杀了刘备。”
sentences.traditional: 這不是好事，我們應該殺了劉備。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè bú shì hǎo shì wǒ men yīng gāi shā le liú bèi
sentences.english: This is not good. We should kill Liu Bei.”

sentences.simplified: 曹操没有说话，心里非常不高兴。他不喜欢皇帝和刘备在一起。
sentences.traditional: 曹操沒有說話，心裡非常不高興。他不喜歡皇帝和劉備在一起。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo méi yǒu shuō huà xīn li fēi cháng bù gāo xìng tā bù xǐ huan huáng dì hé liú bèi zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Cao Cao didn’t say anything and was very unhappy. He didn’t like the emperor and Liu Bei being together.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝是他拿在手里的棋子，他让棋子怎么走，棋子就要怎么走，
sentences.traditional: 皇帝是他拿在手裡的棋子，他讓棋子怎麼走，棋子就要怎麼走，
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì shì tā ná zài shǒu lǐ de qí zǐ tā ràng qí zǐ zěn me zǒu qí zǐ jiù yào zěn me zǒu
sentences.english: The emperor was a pawn in his hands. When he tells the pawn to move, the pawn must move.

sentences.simplified: 棋子不能有自己的想法，更不能有像刘备这样的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 棋子不能有自己的想法，更不能有像劉備這樣的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: qí zǐ bù néng yǒu zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ gèng bù néng yǒu xiàng liú bèi zhè yàng de péng you
sentences.english: The pawn must not have its own ideas, let alone a friend like Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 刘备是个聪明人，
sentences.traditional: 劉備是個聰明人，
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi shì ge cōng ming rén
sentences.english: Liu Bei is a smart man.

sentences.simplified: 虽然现在还没有自己的军队，但以后一定能做大事。
sentences.traditional: 雖然現在還沒有自己的軍隊，但以後一定能做大事。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán xiàn zài hái méi yǒu zì jǐ de jūn duì dàn yǐ hòu yí dìng néng zuò dà shì
sentences.english: Although he doesn’t have his own troops now, he’ll definitely be able to do great things in the future.

sentences.simplified: 这样的人和皇帝走得近，不是好事。
sentences.traditional: 這樣的人和皇帝走得近，不是好事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de rén hé huáng dì zǒu de jìn bú shì hǎo shì
sentences.english: It is not good for such a person to get close to the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 那杀了刘备？虽然杀人不难，但曹操还不想杀他。
sentences.traditional: 那殺了劉備？雖然殺人不難，但曹操還不想殺他。
sentences.pinyin: nà shā le liú bèi suī rán shā rén bù nán dàn cáo cāo hái bù xiǎng shā tā
sentences.english: Then kill Liu Bei? Although it was not difficult to kill him, Cao Cao didn’t want to kill him yet.

sentences.simplified: 第一，刘备是“皇叔”，杀“皇叔”是大事。
sentences.traditional: 第一，劉備是“皇叔”，殺“皇叔”是大事。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī liú bèi shì huáng shū shā huáng shū shì dà shì
sentences.english: First, Liu Bei was the “imperial uncle”, and killing the “imperial uncle” was a big deal.

sentences.simplified: 如果刘备没做坏事，那杀了他，会让其他官员不相信自己。
sentences.traditional: 如果劉備沒做壞事，那殺了他，會讓其他官員不相信自己。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ liú bèi méi zuò huài shì nà shā le tā huì ràng qí tā guān yuán bù xiāng xìn zì jǐ
sentences.english: If Liu Bei hadn’t done anything bad, then killing Liu Bei would make other officials not trust him.

sentences.simplified: 第二，刘备是个聪明人，曹操喜欢聪明人，他希望刘备能做他的人，为他做事。
sentences.traditional: 第二，劉備是個聰明人，曹操喜歡聰明人，他希望劉備能做他的人，為他做事。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr liú bèi shì ge cōng ming rén cáo cāo xǐ huan cōng ming rén tā xī wàng liú bèi néng zuò tā de rén wèi tā zuò shì
sentences.english: Second, Liu Bei was a smart person, and Cao Cao liked smart people. He wanted Liu Bei to be his man and work for him.

sentences.simplified: 但是，人虽然不杀，但曹操还是得让他们知道自己不高兴了，
sentences.traditional: 但是，人雖然不殺，但曹操還是得讓他們知道自己不高興了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì rén suī rán bù shā dàn cáo cāo hái shi děi ràng tā men zhī dào zì jǐ bù gāo xìng le
sentences.english: However, although he wasn’t going to kill him, Cao Cao had to let them know that he was unhappy.

sentences.simplified: 也得让每个人都知道，国家最大的人是他曹操。
sentences.traditional: 也得讓每個人都知道，國家最大的人是他曹操。
sentences.pinyin: yě děi ràng měi ge rén dōu zhī dào guó jiā zuì dà de rén shì tā cáo cāo
sentences.english: He also had to let everyone know that the most important person in the country was him, Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 他想了想，对助手说：
sentences.traditional: 他想了想，對助手說：
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng le xiǎng duì zhù shǒu shuō
sentences.english: He thought about it and said to his assistant, ..

sentences.simplified: “你去告诉皇帝和刘备，明天城里有骑马比赛，
sentences.traditional: “你去告訴皇帝和劉備，明天城裡有騎馬比賽，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ qù gào su huáng dì hé liú bèi míng tiān chéng lǐ yǒu qí mǎ bǐ sài
sentences.english: .. “Go and tell the emperor and Liu Bei that there will be a horse riding competition in the city tomorrow.

sentences.simplified: 要他们带马来比赛。
sentences.traditional: 要他們帶馬來比賽。
sentences.pinyin: yào tā men dài mǎ lái bǐ sài
sentences.english: Ask them to bring their horses to the competition.

sentences.simplified: 也告诉其他官员，让大家都来看比赛。”
sentences.traditional: 也告訴其他官員，讓大家都來看比賽。”
sentences.pinyin: yě gào su qí tā guān yuán ràng dà jiā dōu lái kàn bǐ sài
sentences.english: Also, tell the other officials. Get everyone to come to the competition.”

sentences.simplified: 助手不明白曹操的意思，但也知道不用问，
sentences.traditional: 助手不明白曹操的意思，但也知道不用問，
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu bù míng bai cáo cāo de yì si dàn yě zhī dào bú yòng wèn
sentences.english: The assistant didn’t understand what Cao Cao meant, but he also knew that he didn’t need to ask.

sentences.simplified: 曹大人说什么，自己就去做什么，这一定不会错。
sentences.traditional: 曹大人說什麼，自己就去做什麼，這一定不會錯。
sentences.pinyin: cáo dà ren shuō shén me zì jǐ jiù qù zuò shén me zhè yí dìng bú huì cuò
sentences.english: He would do whatever Lord Cao said. This way, nothing would go wrong.

sentence_translations: Pawn
Cao Cao had been quite busy these days. Yuan Shao in the north had done some great things and taken some territory.
Cao Cao knew that Yuan Shao would soon bring his troops to the south, ..
.. and Cao Cao would be the first person he would fight.
His assistants were very anxious and came to have meetings with Cao Cao every day.
Of course, Cao Cao did not forget about Liu Bei and the emperor.
He asked his smart assistant to follow the emperor to see what he did with Liu Bei every day.
When the assistant returned, he said the same thing every time:
“Lord Cao, the emperor invites Liu Bei to his place every day.
He takes Liu Bei with him whatever he is doing. Liu Bei goes wherever he goes.
This is not good. We should kill Liu Bei.”
Cao Cao didn’t say anything and was very unhappy. He didn’t like the emperor and Liu Bei being together.
The emperor was a pawn in his hands. When he tells the pawn to move, the pawn must move.
The pawn must not have its own ideas, let alone a friend like Liu Bei.
Liu Bei is a smart man.
Although he doesn’t have his own troops now, he’ll definitely be able to do great things in the future.
It is not good for such a person to get close to the emperor.
Then kill Liu Bei? Although it was not difficult to kill him, Cao Cao didn’t want to kill him yet.
First, Liu Bei was the “imperial uncle”, and killing the “imperial uncle” was a big deal.
If Liu Bei hadn’t done anything bad, then killing Liu Bei would make other officials not trust him.
Second, Liu Bei was a smart person, and Cao Cao liked smart people. He wanted Liu Bei to be his man and work for him.
However, although he wasn’t going to kill him, Cao Cao had to let them know that he was unhappy.
He also had to let everyone know that the most important person in the country was him, Cao Cao.
He thought about it and said to his assistant, ..
.. “Go and tell the emperor and Liu Bei that there will be a horse riding competition in the city tomorrow.
Ask them to bring their horses to the competition.
Also, tell the other officials. Get everyone to come to the competition.”
The assistant didn’t understand what Cao Cao meant, but he also knew that he didn’t need to ask.
He would do whatever Lord Cao said. This way, nothing would go wrong.
